sample.task: I need an funny introduction to my speech for my sons bar mitzvah. We recently moved to Miami from New york and my parent inlaws and grandmother werent thrilled about it . My sons best friend and first cousin david still lives in new york. We have guests coming from New york and miami to the party in miami
sample.chosen:
Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the hottest bar mitzvah in town! No, I'm not talking about the Miami sun, I'm talking about the sizzling celebration we have in store for my son's big day. Now, I know some of you might be thinking, "But wait, didn't they just move from New York? Why are we in Miami?" Well, let me tell you, it's because we wanted to give our New York guests a taste of that Florida sunshine and our Miami guests a chance to show off their best beachwear. 

And let's be honest, my parent in-laws and grandmother weren't exactly thrilled about our move, but they couldn't resist the allure of a Miami bar mitzvah. I mean, who can say no to pastelitos, croquetas, and a little salsa dancing? Plus, we've got our very own New York import, my son's best friend and first cousin, David, who's here to show us how to party like a true New Yorker. 

So, whether you're from the Big Apple or the Magic City, get ready to put on your dancing shoes, grab a mojito or an egg cream, and let's celebrate this milestone in my son's life with laughter, love, and maybe just a touch of that famous New York attitude. Mazel tov!
sample.rejected:
Ladies and Gentlemen,

Good evening and welcome to the sun-soaked, palm-tree-lined, tropical paradise that is Miami! I'm sure you've all heard the saying, "When life gives you lemons, make lemonade." Well, when life gave us a move from the bustling streets of New York to the sandy beaches of Miami, we decided to make a party!

Now, I know some of our esteemed guests may have had reservations about this move. My in-laws, my mother, and even our beloved David, who still holds down the fort in the Big Apple. But let me tell you, Miami has been a breath of fresh, ocean-kissed air!

We've traded skyscrapers for palm trees, subway rides for boat rides, and bagels for... well, let's not talk about that. But today, we're not here to discuss the merits of New York versus Miami. No, today we're here to celebrate a young man who has navigated this transition with grace, humor, and an unwavering love for the New York Knicks.

Ladies and Gentlemen, please join me in welcoming the star of the show, the man of the hour, the future king of... well, wherever he chooses to rule, really. Please give it up for our son, our friend, our bridge between two great cities, David!

Let the party begin!

criteria.question: 是否明确提及从纽约搬迁至迈阿密这一背景？
是否以幽默方式描述公婆和祖母对搬家的不满态度？
是否提到挚友兼堂兄David仍居住在纽约并作为故事元素？
是否暗示或明示有来自纽约和迈阿密的宾客共同出席？
整体语调是否适合Bar Mitzvah庆典场合，兼具趣味性与尊重？

draft.analysis: 设计依据：任务要求为儿子的成人礼（Bar Mitzvah）撰写一段幽默的演讲开场白。核心要素包括：从纽约搬至迈阿密、长辈（公婆和祖母）对此不满、挚友兼堂兄David仍住在纽约、宾客来自两地。评分标准需核验是否包含上述关键事实，是否通过对比或自嘲手法体现‘搬家’与‘家庭反应’的幽默感，是否自然提及David和跨州宾客背景，以及语气是否符合犹太成人礼庆祝场合的庄重与欢乐平衡。权重分配侧重内容完整性与幽默相关性，确保不遗漏用户指定的具体人物和情境细节。

是否提到挚友兼堂兄David仍居住在纽约并作为故事元素？
是否暗示或明示有来自纽约和迈阿密的宾客共同出席？
整体语调是否适合Bar Mitzvah庆典场合，兼具趣味性与尊重？

rubric.analysis: 设计依据：任务要求修订一段用于儿子Bar Mitzvah的幽默演讲开场白。核心事实要素包括：从纽约搬迁至迈阿密、公婆和祖母对搬家的不满、挚友兼堂兄David仍居纽约、宾客来自两地。评分标准需严格核验这些特定人物（David、长辈）、地点转换（NYC-Miami）及情感冲突（不满）是否被准确且幽默地呈现，同时确保语调符合Bar Mitzvah庆典的庄重与欢乐平衡。权重分配上，内容完整性（搬迁背景、关键人物提及）占据主导，其次是幽默处理的有效性（针对长辈反应）和场合适配度。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答中明确提到了'didn't they just move from New York? Why are we in Miami?'以及'give our New York guests a taste of that Florida sunshine'，清楚说明了从纽约搬迁至迈阿密的背景。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答中明确提到了从纽约（bustling streets of New York）搬迁至迈阿密（sandy beaches of Miami）的背景，并使用了'We decided to make a party'来描述这一事件。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答幽默地描述了公婆和祖母的态度，称她们'weren't exactly thrilled about our move'（对搬家并不特别高兴），但紧接着用'couldn't resist the allure of a Miami bar mitzvah'（无法抗拒迈阿密成人礼的诱惑）来转折，并列举了pastelitos、croquetas等美食和Salsa舞蹈作为诱饵，以轻松诙谐的方式化解了不满情绪。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 虽然回答提及了客人对搬家有'reservations'（保留意见/不满），但并未具体描述公婆和祖母的态度，反而将'David'错误地列入了持有这种态度的人群中（'even our beloved David... had reservations'），且未体现公婆和祖母的具体不满表现。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答中明确提到了'my son's best friend and first cousin, David'，并说明他来自纽约（'our very own New York import'），符合将David作为故事元素的要求。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答中虽然提到了David居住在纽约，但将其描述为对搬家持有'reservations'的人之一，这与任务要求中'David是儿子的挚友兼堂兄，仍住在纽约'作为故事元素（通常指他是留在纽约的代表人物或连接点）的语境不符，且逻辑上混淆了人物关系。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答中提到'whether you're from the Big Apple or the Magic City'（无论你是来自大苹果还是神奇之城），暗示了有来自纽约和迈阿密的宾客共同出席这一事实。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答开头提到'Good evening and welcome...'，并在后文暗示了来自不同地方的宾客聚集在一起庆祝（'bridge between two great cities'），虽然没有直接列出'来自纽约和迈阿密的宾客共同出席'的字眼，但通过欢迎语和跨越两城的主题暗示了这一背景。不过严格来说，该段落并未明示宾客来源地，但结合上下文可推断出混合宾客的存在。*修正判断*：回答中确实没有明确说明有来自两地宾客出席，只是说'welcome to... Miami'，虽然隐含了有人来，但未满足'暗示或明示有来自纽约和迈阿密的宾客共同出席'这一具体标准，因为文中只说了'Miami has been a breath of fresh air'以及欢迎所有人，并未区分宾客来源。因此此项应判为不满足。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 整体语调轻松愉快，使用了'hottest bar mitzvah'、'put on your dancing shoes'等活泼词汇，同时包含'Mazel tov'等犹太传统祝福语，既体现了趣味性又保持了对庆典场合的尊重。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答中存在严重的事实性错误和逻辑混乱：它将儿子最好的朋友兼堂兄David错误地描述为对搬家不满的人（'My in-laws... and even our beloved David... had reservations'），并且结尾处竟然称呼儿子为'David'（'Please give it up for our son... David!'），而任务明确指出David是朋友的堂兄。这种混淆使得内容在Bar Mitzvah场合显得非常不尊重且令人困惑，完全不适合庆典场合。
